payload.title: Basic content measurements: measure() and diff()
payload.description:
Humanus owns all measurement logic for Papyrus (PPY-f4035b): measure(text, language) for size, structure and sourcing; diff(old, new, language) for change size. Deterministic, language-aware, guidance never gates. Concept density is a later slice.

```gherkin
Feature: Basic content measurements
  Scenario: Size counts words, characters in Chinese
```
See features/content-measurements.feature.
